# Brunswick Corporation Named 2026 Chicago Innovation Award Winner for Enterprise-Wide AI Transformation


[Download as PDF](https://www.brunswick.com/_assets/_46ce505e3ee8ee21e3979b31f8cda529/brunswick/news/2026-11-24_Brunswick_Corporation_Named_2026_Chicago_1022.pdf) November 24, 2026 12:00pm EST


**METTAWA, Ill., Nov. 24, 2026** – Brunswick Corporation (NYSE: BC), the global leader in marine recreation, today announced it is one of the winners of the 25th annual Chicago Innovation Awards, recognized for strategically implementing artificial intelligence to rethink how work gets done across the organization. Brunswick’s AI program has scaled to more than 20 production use cases, delivering measurable gains in efficiency, productivity, decision-making and customer value.


“We did not bolt AI onto existing processes; we redesigned workflows and embedded AI into end-to-end processes.” said Samir Shah, senior vice president and chief information officer, Brunswick Corporation. “With Brunswick AI Intelligence Platform, we are making faster decisions, reducing manual effort and delivering tangible results for our customers and employees. This award is a testament to our talented business and IT teams, who embraced new ways of working and turned a bold idea into measurable value.”


“At Brunswick, AI helps us amplify our distinctive strengths by empowering our people to innovate,” said Jill Wrobel, executive vice president and chief human resources officer, Brunswick Corporation. “Combined with our deep-rooted culture of collaboration and continuous improvement, AI is enabling our business leaders to rethink core workflows and operating models—and shape the future of marine recreation.”


Winners were announced on Nov. 17, 2026, at a sold-out celebration of roughly 700 guests at the UIC Forum in Chicago. The Chicago Innovation Awards are the Chicago region’s foremost recognition of the most innovative new products and services brought to market each year, honoring organizations of every size and industry.


**Sustained innovation and workplace momentum**


The Chicago Innovation Award adds to a growing list of recognition for Brunswick’s innovation leadership and workplace culture. Recent honors include:


- Fast Company | World’s Most Innovative Companies | 2026
- Boating Industry | 15 Top Product Awards across 13 Brunswick brands | 2026
- Newsweek | World’s Most Trustworthy Companies | 2026
- Newsweek | America’s Greatest Workplaces for Women | 2026
- Forbes | America’s Best Companies | 2025


## About Brunswick


Brunswick Corporation (NYSE: BC) is a global leader in marine recreation, delivering innovation that transforms experiences on the water and beyond. Its technology-driven solutions are informed by deep consumer insights and guided by the belief that “Next Never Rests™.” Brunswick is home to more than 60 industry-leading brands across marine propulsion, parts and accessories, marine electronics, as well as boat brands including Boston Whaler, Sea Ray, Bayliner, Lund and Harris. Headquartered in Mettawa, Illinois, Brunswick has approximately 14,000 employees operating in 26 countries. For more information, visit Brunswick.com or the Brunswick Newsroom.
